# Shroom and Gloom Guide

> An unofficial, source-cited fan guide for Shroom and Gloom, the first-person roguelike double-deckbuilder by Team Lazerbeam and Devolver Digital. It focuses on verified demo-build data, exact starter-card text, quests, characters, and mechanics. It does not publish unsupported tier ratings, rarities, or free-text synergy claims.

## Canonical site

- https://shroomandgloom.online/
- Deployment preview: https://shroomgloom.hbwang2076.workers.dev/

## Data scope and editorial policy

- Current data label: Steam demo build 23718635, retrieved 2026-09-02.
- The demo database reports 523 named card pages: 235 Explore, 288 Combat, and 14 Foresight.
- This site currently publishes verified starter-card records and expands card pages only when a card name and text can be checked against a source.
- Early Access launch date: 2026-09-10 (PC), according to Team Lazerbeam's 22 August 2026 Steam dev log.
- Verified facts are sourced from the official Steam store page and developer log, Devolver creator resources, the Shroom and Gloom Fandom starter-card page, and a build-scoped community database.
- When sources conflict, official Team Lazerbeam / Devolver sources take priority over community sources.
- Do not treat player discussion reports as game rules. They are labelled as player reports when used.
- Do not infer a tier rating, rarity, energy cost, synergy, character passive, or per-character starter deck when it is not explicitly published.

## Key pages

- [Home and card search](https://shroomandgloom.online/): Verified-data overview and searchable starter-card records.
- [Cards database](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/): Demo build counts, deck/class filters, exact-text card records, and the editorial policy against unsupported tier lists.
- [Beginner guide](https://shroomandgloom.online/beginner-guide/): Two-deck overview, 13-card starter deck, glossary terms, first-run sequence, and all ten demo quests.
- [Build guide](https://shroomandgloom.online/best-builds/): Mechanics-first build directions based on Vulnerable, Gunk, Battery/Machine, Rage, Toasty, Camp, and Soup systems.
- [Characters](https://shroomandgloom.online/characters/): Five Early Access launch characters, three additional demo-database entries with unconfirmed launch status, and character-unlock quests.
- [Quests](https://shroomandgloom.online/quests/): Ten demo-build quests with exact requirements and reward types.
- [Patch notes](https://shroomandgloom.online/patch-notes/): Demo-build baseline and future verified change log.
- [About and methodology](https://shroomandgloom.online/about/): Fan-site status, data policy, and attribution.

## Verified starter-card records

- [Shovel](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/shovel/): Explore / Gear. Exact text: "Dig for weapons."
- [Key](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/key/): Explore / Pick. Exact text: "Unlock. Consume."
- [Rest](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/rest/): Explore / Skill. Exact text: "Heal 9 Health. Increase this card's healing by 3. Start next combat with Well Rested."
- [Bash](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/bash/): Explore / Pick. Exact text: "Unlock. Deal 4 damage to Self. Handy. Persistent."
- [Map](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/map/): Explore / Skill. Exact text: "Look at Map. Handy. Persistent. Replenish."
- [Rat Jerky](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/rat-jerky/): Explore / Food. Exact text: "Heal 3 Health. Draw 1 card."
- [Flash](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/flash/): Combat / Skill / 0 energy. Exact text: "Add 3 Vulnerable to target. Battery 10."
- [Roast](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/roast/): Combat / Skill / 1 energy. Exact text: "Deal 3 damage. If fatal: create Toasty."
- [Stab](https://shroomandgloom.online/cards/stab/): Combat / Skill / 1 energy. Exact text: "Deal 4 damage."
